extracted.intended_audience: readers and scholars of Renaissance satirical literature (Rabelais)
extracted.subtask_description: A prose excerpt from François Rabelais' Pantagruel containing grotesque, comic anatomical descriptions (Shrovetide), mock-epic episodes (a physeter/whirlpool), and satirical portrayals of peoples (Chitterlings). Useful for close reading, literary analysis, or humor studies of Renaissance satire.
